run_mae_finetune: run the MAE fine-tuning script for image classification on ImageNet with a ViT model
run_mae_evaluation: run evaluation only mode on a pre-trained MAE checkpoint using the --eval flag
build_args_parser: build an argparse parser with MAE fine-tuning hyperparameters including batch size, epochs, and learning rate
finetune_vit_from_checkpoint: finetune a Vision Transformer model from a pre-trained MAE checkpoint with position embedding interpolation
configure_distributed_training: configure distributed training with gradient accumulation and layer-wise learning rate decay
